1.consolidated_definition: mús. Disco de larga duración. Sigla adaptada, frecuente. Desde que compuso el tema “Yo vivo orgulloso de ti” en su elepé “Hola”, Glenn mostró el enorme y profundo amor que sentía y siente por su padre
1.en_consolidated_definition: Musical term. Long-playing record. Abbreviated form frequently used. Since he composed the theme "Yo vivo orgulloso de ti" on his LP "Hola", Glenn showed the enormous and deep love that he felt and feels for his father
